faults.detail: "KAafi PAAS": the word is mistyped as "KAafi" (stray mixed case inside the word; should be "KAAFI PAAS" to match "BILKUL SAHI"). A misspelt word shown to the child as feedback.
"sahi pan" is not a natural Hindi/Hinglish word for accuracy (split, coined form of "sahipan"); not a plain word a class 4 child would recognise as a label.

notes: Wave 3 lists cut "1/2" twice; cannot tell from the packet whether the engine treats this as two separate bars or a duplicate, so not counted.
